page.overview:
What is Akota Reservoir?

Located in the Rocky Mountains, Akota Reservoir is the site of a long abandoned radar station and, as the name suggests, a dam. It would be a perfect place for the Autobots or Decepticons to set up a base, were it not for the fact that the vast underground energon deposits have resulted in the area being overrun by Terrorcons.

Akota Reservoir was the site of many an Autobot and Decepticon foray into trying to wipe out the Terrorcons and secure the area.
